plugin.name: HeartOfMagic.esp (required)
plugin.description:
The SKSE plugin, the spell panel and the Papyrus scripts are always installed. This page adds HeartOfMagic.esp.
HeartOfMagic.esp is a light plugin (ESL-flagged .esp): it takes no load order slot, needs only Skyrim.esm and can go anywhere in your load order. Enable it in your plugin list after installing.
It holds one record: a copy, under a neutral name, of the base-game explosion Mysticism's screen shake uses, with Mysticism's values. Heart of Magic gives that copy to hidden, harmless spell effects whose explosion other mods read as frost by its name (Mysticism's screen shake, which made Frostwalker freeze water under spells such as Hysteria and Harmony). Real frost spells keep the original. With Mysticism, the fix also needs the Mysticism Patch on the next page.

group.name: ISL / DEST / Sit Down and Read / GTS CE Bookworm

plugin.name: Merged ISL Compatibility Patch
plugin.description:
Merged compatibility patch for Immersive Spell Learning - DESTified (by Hackfield), I Just Want to Sit Down and Read (by GiraPomba), and Gate to Sovngarde CE Bookworm trait support.
Replaces DontEatSpellTomes.dll with an inert shim and installs a merged study script that preserves ALL features from every mod:
- Heart of Magic: Spell XP from studying, progression integration - Sit Down and Read: GPMA/OAR animations, ImprovedCameraSE and TrueDirectionalMovement support, 1st-person study - Gate to Sovngarde CE Bookworm trait support: shorter study time when the trait is active (compatibility code only; no GTS CE files included) - Bug fix: Save-load re-registration (prevents spell tome hook from silently breaking)
All features degrade gracefully — if a mod is not installed, its features are simply inactive.
IMPORTANT: Load Heart of Magic AFTER ISL/DEST/GTS/SDR so the merged scripts take priority.
Auto-selected if ISL or DEST is detected. If you don't use ISL, leave this unchecked.

plugin.name: Mysticism Patch (HeartOfMagic_Mysticism.esp)
plugin.description:
For Mysticism - A Magic Overhaul. Without it, Mysticism's master-level spells (Hysteria, Harmony, Fire Storm and others) freeze water when Frostwalker is installed: their hidden screen-shake effect places the Blizzard explosion from its script.
HeartOfMagic_Mysticism.esp is a light plugin (ESL-flagged .esp) with one record, Mysticism's MAG_ScreenShakeEffect, changed only to place HeartOfMagic.esp's neutral copy of that explosion. It needs MysticismMagic.esp and HeartOfMagic.esp.
Load it after HeartOfMagic.esp and after every other plugin that edits MAG_ScreenShakeEffect (Synthesis or sound patches, for example): the last plugin to edit the effect decides.
Only installable when MysticismMagic.esp is active.
